name: init-seed
body: Init seed: the minimal unbranded seed tree (kalide.yaml, slides/1-hello.md, templates/library.yaml, templates/slides/hello/{template.yaml,layout.html.tmpl,example.md}, templates/themes/default/theme.css) embedded in internal/scaffold and copied verbatim by a no-arg `kalide init`. Read only by init. Used only when no path argument is given; `kalide init <path>` writes only `kalide.yaml` (with `templates: <path>`), an empty `slides/`, an empty `assets/` and the `AGENTS.md` guide, its templates coming from the external library at `<path>` (see cli-init, external-template-library). The same on-disk scaffold component also creates a new template library for `kalide init-library` (library.yaml, empty `slides/`, `sections/` and `media/`, and a minimal `themes/default/theme.css` mirroring the seed's default theme; it creates the library structure only, with no templates), via internal/scaffold. The seed tree also carries the project-root `AGENTS.md` deck-author guide (agent-authoring), copied verbatim by writeHelloSeed; the external deck form and init-library write their embedded guide files through the same package, the library form reading its guide like mustReadSeed/DefaultThemeCSS (library-agent-guide, library-guide-layout).
